title: IF-City: Intelligible Fair City Planning to Measure, Explain and Mitigate Inequality
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on operationalizing the ethical concept of fairness in the domain of urban planning. It proposes a framework and a tool specifically designed to measure, explain, and mitigate inequality and unfairness in resource allocation for city residents. This makes the evaluation of ethics (specifically fairness and equity) a core component of the work, rather than a peripheral consideration.
